title: Native HTML5 source-provenance instrumentation seams
question: Can narrow instrumentation preserve html5lib HTML5 semantics while exposing source contributions?
method: Exercise pinned native and instrumented html5lib/lxml on nine independent source cases; inspect cursor, duplicate attributes, tree mutation, buffered text and decoder contributions.
conclusion: Narrow state/stream, pre-emission, tree-mutation and table-buffer hooks support the selected instrumentation route without copying parser algorithms. Complete lexical categorization, composed byte/decoded/newline provenance, final text/tail lineage and canonical projection remain production obligations; nine cases do not qualify complete PP-03 provenance.
